issues.legal_issue: The time limit for depositing the required amounts when seeking to set aside an execution sale is the same as the time limit for filing the application, rather than a separate 30-day limit.
material_facts: Property was sold in execution of a decree.
An application to set aside the sale and the required deposit were made on the 59th day after the sale.
The executing court dismissed the application because the deposit was made after 30 days; the appellate court set aside the sale, and the High Court upheld that decision.
issues.conclusion: The 30-day period does not impose a deadline for making the deposit. An application and deposit may be made within the 60-day application period; if the deposit is made after the first 30 days but within that period, the court has discretion whether to grant the application. The appeal was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Order XXI Rule 89 of the Code of Civil Procedure provides for an application to set aside an execution sale upon deposit but prescribes no time limit for either the application or the deposit. Article 127 of the Limitation Act prescribes the application period, extended from 30 to 60 days, while Order XXI Rule 92(2) provides that the court must set aside the sale when the application is allowed and the deposit is made within 30 days. Rule 92(2) removes the court’s discretion in that circumstance; it does not prohibit a later deposit within the application period. This reading gives effect to the legislative purpose of the extension without adding words to the statute. The court rejected the contrary interpretation in P.K. Unni v. Nirmala Industries and distinguished its conclusion from the harmonising approach in Basavantappa v. Gangadhar Narayan Dharwadkar; it also applied the general statutory interpretation principles discussed in P.K. Unni.

predicates.execution_sale_set_aside_application: A person seeks to have a sale conducted in execution of a decree set aside.
predicates.initial_deposit_window_elapsed: The required deposit is made after the period in which the court is required to set aside the sale if the application is allowed.
predicates.application_and_deposit_within_applicabl: The application and required deposit are made within the period allowed for filing the application.

issues.definition: When a person seeks to set aside an execution sale and makes the application and deposit within the applicable filing period but after the initial deposit window, the court retains discretion to allow the application.
